title: Keyfactor PFX Enrollment Request Schema
description: Schema for PFX certificate enrollment in Keyfactor Command

Stores.description: Stores to deploy the certificate to during enrollment

StoreId.description: Unique identifier for the certificate store

Alias.description: Alias for the certificate in the store

Overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing certificate with the same alias

Properties.description: Additional properties for the store deployment

CustomFriendlyName.description: Custom friendly name for the certificate

IncludeChain.description: Whether to include the certificate chain in the response

IncludeSubjectHeader.description: Whether to include the subject header in the response

RenewalCertificateId.description: ID of the certificate to renew

CertificateAuthority.description: Name of the certificate authority to use for enrollment

Metadata.description: Metadata to associate with the certificate

AdditionalEnrollmentFields.description: Additional enrollment fields required by the template

Template.description: Name of the certificate template to use for enrollment

SANs.description: Subject Alternative Names to include in the certificate

InstallIntoExistingCertificateStores.description: Whether to install the certificate into existing certificate stores

JobTime.description: Scheduled time for the job to run

ChainOrder.description: Order of certificates in the chain

KeyLength.description: Length of the key in bits for RSA keys

Curve.description: Curve to use for ECC keys

AlternativeKeyType.description: Alternative key type if the primary is not available

AlternativeKeyLength.description: Alternative key length if the primary is not available

MicrosoftTargetCSP.description: Microsoft CSP target for certificate enrollment

OwnerRoleId.description: ID of the role that will own the certificate

OwnerRoleName.description: Name of the role that will own the certificate

EnrollmentPatternId.description: ID of the enrollment pattern to use
